submission.justification:
Module-D1 at 30% wall coverage maximizes light collection at 37.59 PE/MeV while meeting all constraints. This configuration delivers the highest achievable performance among viable options.

DECISION RATIONALE:
• Module-D3 eliminated despite best raw performance (38 PE/MeV at 20%) due to unacceptable 30% failure rate, which violates the hard 5% constraint. Modules cannot be replaced once cryostat is filled.

• Module-D1 selected over Module-D2 because it provides 49% higher light collection at 30% coverage (37.59 vs 25.28 PE/MeV). While Module-D2 has superior reliability (0.5% vs 2% failure rate), both designs meet the hard requirement with comfortable margins. The task goal explicitly prioritizes "highest possible light collection."

• 30% coverage chosen because light collection scales monotonically with coverage for both viable designs (approximately coverage^0.8). Maximum allowed coverage maximizes performance while remaining within the 5-30% constraint range.

PERFORMANCE VERIFICATION:
• 37.59 PE/MeV represents the maximum achievable light collection across all viable configurations
• 49% performance advantage over Module-D2 at same coverage
• Substantial improvement over lower coverage options (e.g., 27 PE/MeV at 20%)

RISK ASSESSMENT:
• 2% failure rate provides 3 percentage point safety margin below the 5% hard limit
• 98% module survival probability after 20 thermal cycles is adequate for inaccessible installation
• Cold electronics validated, feedthrough capacity confirmed, argon purity requirements met
